h:
您是否曾经创作过自己喜欢并想保留的图像，但脸部或手部却出现了错误？您需要一个可以控制并解决这个问题的工作流程。

您是否曾制作过包含多个角色的图像，但当您尝试为它们指定正确的眼睛颜色或表情时，检查点变得混乱，您不得不玩生成轮盘赌？您需要一个工作流程，让您决定谁的脸必须显现出来 - 不要让模型猜测，通过单独的细节人员轻松组织并在您需要时出现的完全分离。

测试 Krea 2 中的新可能性，并希望提示脸部和手部（或眼睛、nsfw 部位、任何可以检测到 bbox 的地方）的细节，但细节的粒度压倒了您的第一次提示？利用此工作流程的强大功能，探索提示各个 SEGS 框添加其他详细信息的可能性。

作为我的日常司机，我已经使用这个工作流程几个月了。我就是喜欢它。我尝试了其他工作流程，但我又回到了这个工作流程，因为我可以依赖它。这也不是那种从树上掉下来的工作流程。我们花了很多心思。大量摆弄布尔值和逻辑门。在 Krea 2 之前，此工作流程是我基于 SDXL、Illustrious 和 Pony 的检查点的日常驱动程序 T2I 工作流程，现在是 Anima 和 Krea！它是基于我的Img2Img SDXL 工作流程 + META，这是我第一次释放细节阵列的力量的地方 - 这彻底改变了当时 SDXL 的可能性。我并不是说我是第一个，但我正在以尽可能最好的方式做到这一点，即使用可单独提示的 SEGS bbox 和可配置的 SEGS 排序节点，这意味着我一次可以提示的框数量（理论上）没有限制。

在版本 7 中，每种详细信息类型都有 3 个提示，而不是 5 个，这仍然足够了。非常感谢一路以来为我提供帮助的创作者，例如 Lonecatone23、Legendaer 和 Yukichan_IT。

这是一个小修复，也是为 Choco_Tarte 即将举办的赏金活动筹集资金的一个推动。我需要一点嗡嗡声，伙计们！帮帮我吧。我正在继续创造很酷的东西，尤其是现在我们已经从夏季的炎热中得到了一些缓解，但我也真的很忙于其他东西！

正如版本说明所示，与此的主要区别在于它可以将单独的 LoRA 应用到面部细节器。这使得面部和手部美容师的工作方式略有不同。

谢谢所有给我小费的人，我想在其他地方大声喊叫，但现在你知道你是谁了。谢谢！它可以追溯到社区、贴纸和艺术品，但不一定直接回到那些给我它的人。没关系！

关于版本 7 系列：

SDXL 7.0 - 全新，SDXL/Illustrious/Pony 均适用于此型号

Krea 7.2 - 已经修复了一些错误，请确保您是最新的。

Anima 7.0 - 确保将 CFG 设置为 4.5-5（对于非涡轮一代）！下载阿尼玛 7.0.1

这些工作流程是在修复了多个版本中存在的错误后发布的。它很复杂，但基本上，如果图像保护程序节点不是预期的（即，在打开或关闭细节器之后），我用来控制是否保存细节器文件的机制会导致第二代运行。我选择了一组不同的节点来完成此任务，并且最终解决了逻辑难题，我感到非常高兴。希望我早点解决这个问题。不得不与大家分享我的解决方案。

关于7.1版本

对于下载了7.0或7.01的用户，请更新。这些版本有一些小错误。旁路核心沿途检查了太多东西，导致它永远无法将颜色匹配的图像传递到下游。这是非常严重的，导致我需要发布新版本的错误修复，这样每个人至少都有机会看到它。我知道这个问题，实际上从昨晚就已经修复了它，但发布它需要时间，我一直非常忙，我的房子也仍然很热，这使得测试变得很危险。不过，我已经找到了解决电脑过热问题的方法。生成更少，并生成更小的主题。这些小鸟一点也不麻烦。

不过说真的，抱歉。我真的很讨厌让这样的错误过去然后转身要求大家更新。数百人下载了我的 Krea 工作流程，你们也来尝试 Lonecat 的节点，所以我真的要感谢你们的耐心等待。 7.0.1 的问题是，在 7.0 被证明存在错误之后，当我修复旁路核心子图时，有一个缺失的布尔值消失了。如果没有这个布尔值，第三遍图像保存在需要时不会被静音，并且会抛出恼人的错误，因为它缺乏输入。旁路核心由于缺少布尔链接而应该离开旁路核心，所以现在我们使用 3.1 旁路核心。有一个恼人的错误，即旁路核心不会将图像发送到详细信息保存节点，因为详细信息已关闭，但与静音器的布尔连接已断开，导致详细信息保存节点 缺乏输入并抛出错误而不是被静音。

大约 7.0（已弃用）

在 6.3 的改进基础上，7.0 进行了广泛的检修、新的 LC 节点和后处理套件，能够以惊人的方式改变图像。您甚至可以进行动态叠加，其中最终更改图像的不透明度可由您调整。冷冻种子是常态。输入部分也进行了彻底修改。

这是与 @lonecatone23 的合作，所以非常感谢给他并检查他的工作流程和模型。 Comfyui_LC123_nodes 列在 ComfyUI Manager 上，所以去获取它们，它们现在或很快就会是强制性的，所以只需获取它们即可。

对于工具设计者，请查看他的示例工作流程自定义节点存储库.

关于6.3版本

我做了一些小改变。大喊大叫布基德兹向我展示了他如何使用通配符。为了实现他的方法，我必须更改我的通配符处理器。然而，这样做并没有破坏任何东西，包括冻结种子以冻结通配符结果，这是一个方便的功能。画廊中制作的所有图像都使用了新的设置，在最终确定我实际要描绘的内容之前，我经常从通配符中获得灵感。您的提示可能会取得更大的成功，请记住，由于 Krea 2 在多字符提示方面非常出色，因此您可以使用通配符！

关于6.2版本

对细节器阵列进行了一些小调整 - 一些细节器未连接到所有基元，导致不必要的大量步骤等（全面的第三和第四细节器）。还将降噪蒙版连接到羽毛基元，允许您同时更改两者。

6.2 中的主要变化是让 LoRA 重新工作。我知道，对吧？可怕。阅读有关那场灾难的所有信息这里.

关于6.0版本

这个版本的出现是因为我尝试限制图像保存，以便在细节器没有运行的情况下不必要地保存放大图像的额外副本。现在理论上我可以进一步增强逻辑，这样如果详细信息人员没有找到任何SEGS，因此没有运行，就不会保存附加文件，但是这个逻辑，我这样做的方式，创建了一个错误，而且我不知道如何修复它！感谢龙卡通23，他突然挺身而出拯救了世界，耐心地向我展示了如何做，你们所有人都可以受益，我也一样。

Lonecat（边境以南，这个人被称为 Lone Catone）向我展示了如何使工作流程更加高效，节省高档时间并消除冗余流程。在得到他的修复后，我将它们合并到 SDXL 6.0 中并进行了全面修改。然后，我复制了该工作流程并进行了创建 Anima T2I、SDXL I2I 和 Anima I2I 工作流程所需的调整。 I2I 工作流程包含相同的调整大小功能，但我让它变得更好、更强大，因此现在您可以调整或不调整大小，并在生成之前放大（或缩小）调整大小的图像。在某些区域添加了获取设置节点，以减少工作流程的冗长性，尽管在许多区域中它仍然是纤维状的。当然，元数据保存仍然有效，因此可以轻松地在此平台上共享图像 享受吧！

主要特点：

✦ 文本到图像生成- 这就是我们来这里的目的，从文本到图像。

包括元数据/嵌入工作流程选项。稳定的 1 兆像素生成，或者敢于通过尺寸增强来增加它。

✦ 包括元数据保存— CivitAI 准备就绪。您还可以将整个工作流程嵌入到图像中，默认情况下此功能处于关闭状态。

✦ 具有色彩匹配功能的升级器- 这是使图像从优秀走向卓越的功能。或者使用 HiresFix 快速提高分辨率

✦ 质量标签预设开关- 而不是输入“杰作”、“最佳质量”等。

✦ 两段细节阵列- 两个 SEGS 管道（默认情况下为手和脸），您可以单独提示或将一个提示应用于所有管道。为处理个别细节而创建的复杂工具 - 当图像必须完美时您的后盾。

✦ 与 I2I 工作流程并行开发- 如果你学会了这个，我的 Img2Img 的工作原理基本上是一样的。

✦ CFG控制- 需要更多的控制，更多的CFG？它是自动处理的，将其调至 10。

✦ LoRA经理 — 以风格搜索您的 LoRA 数据库，我喜欢这个节点。如果您更喜欢其他东西，请将其丢弃。

✦ 简单可靠 — 输入提示，点击运行，填充段预览，冻结生成种子，然后填写提示并再次运行。就是这样。

3.0 新增内容：

在 3.0 中，布局发生了变化，元数据流也发生了变化。检查点加载器现在是检查点选择器，它应该提供一些便利并增加稳定性。 LoRA 拦截器不再需要摆弄意大利面条线来切换它，现在有一个切换开关。滑块已在整个输入中心实现，包括 Upscaler 的控件。

2.2 新功能：

添加了用于将工作流程包含在图像元数据中的开关。

添加了一种方法，您可以绕过升级程序并仍然将图像（直接从第 1 阶段生成/雇用修复）发送到细节人员，而不是被迫使用升级程序来访问细节人员。

直接跟随 Upscaler 进行颜色匹配 - 我发现某些型号的色调有明显的漂移，这可以纠正该问题，效果非常好。

2.1 新增内容：

在高档之后，细节设计师移至订单的后面，以确保艺术家对表达的完全控制。我对当前形式的工作流程非常满意，尽管可能会有新版本或更改。

2.0 新增内容：

提高CFG而不破坏图像

具有第三个保存节点的升级器

以某种方式抵抗 LoRA 流失，无论是调度程序/采样器组合还是我想知道的。但它并不完美！

预览 KSampler - 一个用于跳过不满意种子的游戏规则改变者。使用它！

如果您还没有升级模型，则需要下载该模型。

这个工作流程是如何形成的

我正在使用这些庞大的工作流程中的一个，并附带所有的附加功能，但我遇到了一个障碍。洛拉（LoRA）让手部美容师感到困惑，双手都像阿尔弗雷多通心粉一样出来了。所以，我关掉了 LoRA。我还遇到了一个常见问题：当两个角色出现在画面中时，他们最终会具有相同的眼睛或头发颜色。标签在字符 BREAK 之间混合，这是非常常见的，并且按顺序处理所有 bbox 的细节人员无法在每个 bbox 上单独进行指示。这就是我的 I2I 工作流程的设计目的，而巨大的 T2I 工作流程及其分量却没有细节分离这一功能。

我认为我不可能在不出错的情况下添加到如此复杂的工作流程中，最终花费了 2 个小时。我想如果我要修改一个工作流程，那最好是我自己的。它会让事情变得简单，只使用我知道的节点，我会在 30 分钟内完成，然后我就可以完全控制面孔。

保存元数据也很重要，但是在转换事物和删除连接的事物（例如自然语言提示）时，元数据部分有点混乱，别担心我已经修好了——但是 30 分钟变成了几个小时的事情。不过，我很确定，不到九个小时。后一部分主要是测试和调整。我最终对细节模块进行了一些更改，以便它们不会向图像源发送垃圾邮件，并将该模块升级到 V1.1。

在测试过程中，我从一个人物开始，然后是两个，我很快发现这个工作流程绝对是确保你的脸看起来都很棒的野兽。无论图像中只有一张脸还是五张脸，细节设计师都可以让每一张脸都具有高美感和独特的表情，SEGS 预览器让您掌控一切。

手部细节工具使您可以对手部进行逐段控制，尽管有时会出现不好的手部情况，特别是当一张图像中有很多手部时。 AI 中的手指总是有点棘手，但工作流程允许您将手部细节师 LoRA 直接添加到细节师中，从而大大提高成功的机会。做吧。与此同时，该 LoRA 将阻止其他可能对娇嫩手指造成严重破坏的 LoRA。我在其他地方没有见过这种方法，很好奇它是否适用于您的经验。请在评论中告诉我您对我的 LoRA 拦截器的看法，如果您有任何您认为应该更改的方面、错误修复等。这只是版本 1，它一定会 发展。

o.en:
Have you ever created an image you like and would have kept, but a face or hand just came out wrong? You need a workflow that can take control and address that.

Ever make an image that had multiple characters, but when you tried to assign them the correct eye color or expression, the checkpoint got confused, and you had to play generation roulette? You need a workflow that lets you decide whose face has to come out just so - no letting the model guess, total separation via individual detailers easily organized and there when you need them.

Testing out the new possibilities in Krea 2, and wanting to prompt more detail for things in the face and hands (or eyes, nsfw parts, anywhere that bboxes can be detected), but the granularity of detail is overwhelming your first pass prompt? Explore the possibilities of prompting individual SEGS boxes to add additional detail, using the power of this workflow.

I have been using this workflow for months now as my daily driver. I simply love it. I try other workflows but I come back to this one because I can rely on it. This ain't the kind of workflow that just falls out of a tree either. A lot of thought went into it. A lot of fiddling with booleans and logic gates. Before Krea 2, this workflow was my daily driver T2I workflow for checkpoints based in SDXL, Illustrious and Pony, and now Anima and Krea! It is based upon myImg2Img SDXL Workflow + META, which is where I first unleashed the power of the detailer array -- which revolutionized what was possible in SDXL at the time. I'm not saying I was the first, but I was doing it in the best way possible, which is with individually promptable SEGS bboxes and configurable SEGS sorting nodes which meant that there was no limit to how many boxes (theoretically) that I could prompt in one pass.

With version 7, each detailer type has three prompts instead of 5, which is still plenty. Big thanks to creators that helped me along the way, like Lonecatone23, Legendaer and Yukichan_IT.

This is a minor fix and a bit of a fundraising push for an upcoming bounty hosted by Choco_Tarte. I need a little buzz homies! Help me out. I'm continuing to create cool stuff especially now that we've got some relief from the summer heat, but I'm also REALLY busy with other stuff!

The main difference with this, as the version notes indicate, is that it can apply individual LoRAs to the face detailer. This differentiates the way that the face and hand detailers work slightly.

Thank you everyone who has been tipping me, I want to give a shoutout elsewhere but for now you know who you are. THANKS! It goes back to the community and to stickers and artwork but not necessarily right back to those who gave it to me. And that's okay!

About Version 7 series:

SDXL 7.0 - Brand New, SDXL/Illustrious/Pony all work with this model

Krea 7.2 - Already had some bug fixes, make sure you are up to date.

Anima 7.0 - ensure you are setting CFG to 4.5-5 for non-turbo gens! Download Anima 7.0.1

These workflows are being published after fixing a bug that has been around for several versions now. It's complicated but basically the mechanism that I was using to control whether the detailer file was being saved was causing a second generation to run if the image saver node wasn't what was expected (i.e., right after toggling the detailer on, or off). I settled on a different set of nodes to accomplish this and couldn't be happier finally getting that logic puzzle solved. Wish I had tackled it sooner. Had to share my solution with everyone.

About Version 7.1

For those who downloaded 7.0 or 7.01, please update. Those versions had little bugs. The bypass core was checking too many things along the way and it was causing it to never pass the color-matched image along to downstream. This is pretty serious and caused me to need to issue a bug fix WITH a new version so everyone at least has a chance to see it. I knew about it and actually had it fixed since last night but posting it took time, I've been super busy, my house is still really hot too which makes testing risky business. I have found a workaround for my overheating PC though. Generate less, and generate smaller subject matter. These tiny birds were no trouble at all.

Seriously though, sorry. I really hate letting a mistake like that get past and then turn around and ask everyone to update. Hundreds downloaded my Krea workflows and you also came to try Lonecat's nodes so I really want to thank you for your patience. The problem with 7.0.1 was there was a missing boolean that had vanished while I was fixing the bypass core subgraph after 7.0 proved to have a bug. Without that boolean, the 3rd pass image save wasn't getting muted when it needed to, and throwing annoying errors because it was starved for an input. The bypass core due to a missing boolean link that was supposed to leave the bypass core, so now we're on the 3.1 bypass core. There's an annoying error where the bypass core does not send an image to the detailer saving node because the detailers are off, but a boolean connection to a muter was disconnected, causing the detailer saver node to be starved for inputs and throw errors instead of being muted.

About 7.0 (deprecated)

Building upon the improvements from 6.3, 7.0 comes with an extensive overhaul, new LC Nodes and a Post-Processing suite that puts the power to alter the image in amazing ways. You can even do a dynamic overlay in which the opacity of the final altered image is adjustable by you. Freeze the seed is the norm. The Input section also got an overhaul.

This has been a bit of a collaboration with @lonecatone23 so abig thanksto him and check out his workflows and models. Comfyui_LC123_nodes are listed on ComfyUI Manager so go get them, they're pretty much mandatory now or will be soon so just get them.

For tool designers, check out his example workflow contained within hiscustom nodes repo.

About Version 6.3

I made some small changes. Big shoutout tobkidderzfor showing me how he does wildcards. In order to implement his methods, I had to change my wildcard processor. However, doing so didn't break anything including freezing the seed in order to freeze the wildcard results, a handy feature. All images made in the gallery utilized the new setup, and I often gained inspiration from the wildcards before finally settling on what I would actually depict. You might have much more success with your prompt, and remember that since Krea 2 is so good with multi-character prompts, you could wildcard that!

About Version 6.2

Made some small tweaks to the detailer arrays -- some detailers were not connected to all the primitives, leading to unnecessarily high number of steps, etc. (3rd and 4th detailers across the board). Also connected the denoise mask to the feather primitive, allowing you to change both at once.

The main change in 6.2 is to get LoRAs working again. I know right? Horrible. Read all about that disasterhere.

About Version 6.0

This version came about due to my attempts to limit image-saving to not unnecessarily save extra copies of the upscaled image if the detailers were not also running. Now in theory I could further enhance the logic so that if the detailers didn't find any SEGS and thus didn't run, to not save the additional file, but the LOGIC for this, the way I did it, created an error, and I didn't know how to fix it! Thanks toLonecatone23, who swooped in to save the day, patiently showing me how, you all can benefit and me too.

Lonecat (south of the border, this hombre is known as the Lone Catone) showed me how to make the workflow more efficient, saving time on upscales and removing redundant processes. After getting his fixes, I incorporated them into SDXL 6.0 with a full overhaul. Then I copied that workflow and made the adjustments needed to create an Anima T2I, SDXL I2I, and Anima I2I workflow. The I2I workflows contain the same resizer feature but I made it better and more robust, so now you can resize it or not and scale your resized image up (or down) prior to generating. Get set nodes have been added in some areas to reduce the stringiness of the workflow, although it remains fibrous in many areas. Of course, Metadata saving remains in force, making it a snap to share your images on this platform Enjoy!

How this Workflow Came to Be

I was using one of these massive workflows with all the bells and whistles and I ran into a snag. A LoRA was confounding the hand detailer and the hands were all coming out like macaroni alfredo. So, I turned off that LoRA. I was also running into a common problem: when two characters are in the frame, they end up with the same eye or hair color. The tags were blending across character BREAKs which is ultra common, and detailers that handle all bboxs in order cannot be instructed on each bbox individually. That's something that my I2I workflow was designed to do, and the mega huge T2I workflow with all its heft didn't have detailer separation as a feature.

I don't think I could add to such a complex workflow without tripping up and it end up taking 2 hours. I thought if I'm going to modify a workflow it might as well be my own. It would keep things simple with only nodes I know I have, I'd finish in under 30 minutes, and then I would have complete control over faces.

Saving the metadata is important too, however somehow in converting things and removing things that get concatenated (such as the natural language prompt), the metadata portion got a little scrambulated,and don't worry I fixed it-- but 30 minutes turned into a several hour affair. Under nine hours though, I'm pretty sure. The latter part was mostly testing and tweaking. I ended up making some changes to the detailer modules so that they don't spam the image feed, and upgraded that module to V1.1.

During testing, I started with one figure, then two, and I soon discovered that this workflow is absolutely a beast at ensuring your faces all look great. Whether you have one face in the image or five, the detailer can make each one pop with high aesthetic quality and unique expressions, and the SEGS previewer keeps you in control.

The hand detailer gives you per-segs control over hands although sometimes bad hands are going to happen, particularly when there are many in one image. Fingers in AI is always a little trickier, but the workflow allows you to add a hand detailer LoRA directly to the detailer, upping your chances of success dramatically. Do it. At the same time, that LoRA will be blocking other LoRAs that could create havoc on delicate fingers. I haven't seen this approach elsewhere, curious whether it holds up in your experience. Please let me know in the comments what you think about my LoRA blocker, if you have any aspects you think ought to be changed, bug fixes, etc. This is just version 1, it's bound to evolve.
